description: Build the Dashboard page with Chart.js: pie chart (Retidos vs Cancelados), line chart (daily history with 3 lines), and productivity table per atendente. Also add new Suspensos metrics cards and operator performance chart/table.
steps: In apps-script/Index.html: Add Chart.js CDN script tag in the <head>: <script src='https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js'></script>

In apps-script/Index.html: Replace the placeholder content of #page-dashboard with a full dashboard layout containing: (a) a grid row with 2 chart cards side by side - left card for pie chart (canvas id='chart-pie-retencao'), right card for line chart (canvas id='chart-line-historico'), (b) below that, a productivity table showing Atendente, Total Solicitacoes, Cancelados, Retidos per operator. Use the same bg-gray-800 rounded-xl border border-gray-700 card pattern.

In apps-script/Index.html: Add a loadDashboard() function that calls google.script.run.getDashboardData() and on success: (a) renders the pie chart using Chart.js with labels ['Retidos','Cancelados'] and data from response.pieData, (b) renders the line chart with x-axis as dates and 3 datasets (Total, Cancelados, Retidos) from response.lineData, (c) populates the productivity table rows from response.productivityData
In apps-script/Index.html: Update navigateTo() function to call loadDashboard() when page==='dashboard'

In apps-script/Index.html: Add new metrics cards section at the top of #page-suspensos - a second row of cards (below existing 4) with 3 cards: 'Qtd. Placas' (id='stat-susp-placas'), 'Valores a Receber' (id='stat-susp-a-receber'), 'Valor Recebido (OK)' (id='stat-susp-recebido-ok'). Use appropriate colors (purple, blue, green).

In apps-script/Index.html: Add an operator performance section below the suspensos metrics cards and above the filters - a card with title 'Desempenho por Operador' containing a responsive table with columns: Atendente, Valor a Receber, Valor Recebido (OK), Atendimentos. Give it id='table-body-susp-performance'.

In apps-script/Index.html: Update the loadSuspensos() function to also call google.script.run.getSuspensosMetrics() and on success: populate the 3 new metric cards AND render the operator performance table rows
Ensure all Chart.js instances are properly destroyed before re-creating (store chart instances in variables like var pieChart=null, var lineChart=null, and call .destroy() before new Chart())
acceptance_criteria: Chart.js CDN is loaded in the HTML head
#page-dashboard contains a pie chart canvas and a line chart canvas with proper Chart.js initialization
A productivity table in the dashboard shows per-atendente data
loadDashboard() function exists and is called when navigating to dashboard page
#page-suspensos has 3 new metric cards (Placas, Valores a Receber, Valor Recebido OK)
loadSuspensos() calls getSuspensosMetrics() and populates both cards and performance table
verification: Grep for 'chart.js' CDN link in Index.html
Grep for 'stat-susp-placas' and 'stat-susp-a-receber' and 'stat-susp-recebido-ok' in Index.html
Grep for 'getSuspensosMetrics' call in the loadSuspensos function
findings: All 8 steps implemented successfully. Chart.js CDN added in head. Dashboard page has pie chart (amber for retidos, gray for cancelados), line chart (blue/red/amber for total/cancelados/retidos with dark theme scales), and productivity table. navigateTo calls loadDashboard for dashboard page. Suspensos page has 3 new metrics cards (purple/blue/green) and operator performance table. loadSuspensos now calls getSuspensosMetrics to populate new elements. Chart instances stored in pieChart/lineChart vars and destroyed before recreation.
